prompts.character: Create a production-quality 2D game animation director board for the EXACT three merchant characters in the reference image, preserving their identity, costume, colors, props, proportions, painterly rendering, and full-body silhouette. Layout: clean 3-row by 5-column contact sheet, one merchant per row in the same row order as the reference: Player Upgrades inventor, Gear Merchant dwarf, Bobo dog merchant. No titles, labels, borders, arrows, or text. Each row is one continuous, restrained anchored micro-walk cycle that makes the NPC feel alive without free roaming. Column 1 weight-shift anticipation at the standing anchor; column 2 first foot contact; column 3 passing pose with clear opposing arm/prop motion; column 4 second foot contact; column 5 soft settle and glance back toward the player. Preserve the existing held props and make their secondary motion physically believable: blueprint/tool belt for inventor, backpack/pickaxe/beard for dwarf, ears/tail/bottle/medallion for Bobo. Full bodies and both feet fully visible in every cell, consistent orthographic camera, identical character scale within each row, stable lighting, transparent or perfectly uniform near-black background, generous separation between cells. Motion should read at about 138 px gameplay height: strong leg, torso, head, hand and prop arcs; avoid tiny facial-only changes. No running, no combat, no new items, no costume changes, no extra limbs, no duplicate characters inside a cell, no cropped feet. This is a review-only walk-cycle mockup, not a UI screen.
prompts.creature: Create a production-quality 2D game animation director board for the EXACT three creature merchants in the reference image, preserving their identity, materials, colors, props, proportions, painterly rendering, and full-body silhouette. Layout: clean 3-row by 5-column contact sheet, one merchant per row in the same row order as the reference: Money Monster, Gem Power Merchant, Magma Money Monster. No titles, labels, borders, arrows, or text. Each row is one continuous, restrained anchored micro-walk cycle that makes the NPC feel alive without free roaming. Column 1 weight-shift anticipation at the standing anchor; column 2 first foot contact; column 3 passing pose with readable counter-motion; column 4 second foot contact; column 5 soft settle and player-facing glance. Give each creature a distinct locomotion personality: Money Monster uses a sly short shuffle while protecting pouch and coins, with necklaces and loose coins lagging; Gem Power Merchant uses a heavy crystal-laden two-step with staff and shoulder crystals counterbalancing; Magma Money Monster uses a furnace-heavy stomp with scale pans, chains, chest, coins and ember fragments reacting by weight. Full bodies and feet fully visible in every cell, consistent orthographic camera, identical character scale within each row, stable lighting, transparent or perfectly uniform near-black background, generous separation between cells. Motion must read at about 138 px gameplay height through clear legs, torso, eye/head, hand, prop and secondary-motion arcs. No running, no combat, no new items, no costume or anatomy changes, no extra limbs, no duplicate creatures inside a cell, no cropped feet. This is a review-only walk-cycle mockup, not a UI screen.
